lessons.rule: Numbers-First Reverse Engineering on Kalodata US before any eye test: require 2+ dated revenue/sales points and download the #1 top-revenue video first.
lessons.why: Organic feed scrolling wastes time on low-intent entertainment; Kalodata US revenue rankings prove real buyer wallet intent.

lessons.rule: Enforce the 4-Way Unbiased Market Pricing & <35% Landed Cost Gate across CJdropshipping/HyperSKU, Amazon US (/dp/B0...), legitimate Shopify stores, and scam-store detection.
lessons.why: Healthy Meta CBO unit economics require at least a 3x markup (<35% landed cost) and a verified $22-$30+ break-even CPA.

lessons.rule: Run Two-Layer Meta Competitor & Mechanism Research: check both direct exact-SKU competitors and 2+ same-category alternative mechanisms on Meta Ad Library.
lessons.why: Buyers compare mechanisms (e.g. automated electric vs manual hand tools); proving why our physical mechanism is in its own lane creates the angle gap.

lessons.rule: Never use search-result URLs for suppliers or competitors; always save exact product detail URLs (/product/detail, /dp/B0...) and a clean supplier photo in resources/sourcing/.
lessons.why: Exact links and saved supplier photos make sourcing quotes and verification 100% repeatable with zero broken references.

lessons.rule: Split Website Headlines vs Meta Ad Hooks: keep the storefront product title clean and boutique-grade while putting viral scroll-stopper hooks in Meta ads and purchase.hook.
lessons.why: Cold scrollers need an visceral hook to click the ad, but once on the product page they need high-trust retail clarity to check out.

lessons.rule: Deconstruct the #1 viral video into 20 4:5 static ads (10 Problem-Aware + 10 Solution-Aware) paired with the 5x5 sbc-statics-2.0 copy pack and real product truth photos.
lessons.why: One reference layout per static ad plus concrete domino-chain copy lets Meta test 20 distinct angles simultaneously on Day 1.

lessons.rule: Clone base-theme.json for every new product store and configure 2 Kits Only (1-Kit + paid shipping vs 2-Kit SAVE 15% + Free Shipping) plus the $4.99 Shipping Protection toggle.
lessons.why: 2-Kit pricing lifts AOV without 3-Kit decision fatigue, and cloning base-theme.json preserves our 375px mobile conversion layout.

lessons.rule: Launch in a $50/day CBO with a $50 first-test loss limit, hold the 4-Day Meta Algorithm Priming window, and enforce the End-of-Day 3 Kill Gate if 0 sales and weak ATC/IC.
lessons.why: Clear pre-launch guardrails protect downside capital while giving Meta enough signal to find buyers before scaling winners.

lessons.rule: Keep Launchroom as the single source of truth: run os.mjs status and os.mjs doctor at session start, and save every product, check, creative, and store edit where Launchroom reads it.
lessons.why: Work that is not saved in Launchroom cannot be seen by the owner or built on by the next subagent.
